what: Keep levers for the cycle-3 pick (B + H'' without work_mode, decider): where the missed Keeps go, what the wrong Keeps share, why the Keep rate falls, what each lever does to (true Keeps, wrong Keeps) with a paired 95% two-way bootstrap interval, and the test-5 size a lever needs. Stored files only; aggregates only.
slices: t4_pass = fresh test 4 eligibility-pass rows (the pass bar's slice), t4_all = all test-4 rows, t123_all = fresh tests 1-3 pooled (leave-one-test-out for fitted levers; the pick is in-sample there), t123_pass its pass slice

fit_rules.count_match: a threshold that trades Keeps is set so final Keep calls on the fit tests equal the pick's there; a refit t_lo matches the pick's Skip calls outside H''
fit_rules.net: levers that only remove or only add Keeps maximise true minus wrong Keeps on the fit tests; ties to the smaller change
fit_rules.where: fit on tests 1-3 pooled -> test 4; tests 1-3 numbers are leave-one-test-out

intervals: d_true_keep and d_wrong_keep are [point, 2.5%, 97.5%] of lever minus pick on shared draws; *_crosses_zero says whether the interval holds 0

3_keep_rate.note: Keep rate = gold Keep share. Shift-share against a reference test, per cell definition: mix effect = sum over cells (w_t - w_ref) * r_ref, label effect = sum w_t * (r_t - r_ref); they add up to the change. A cell absent from the reference uses r_ref = 0. 'Label effect' means the same design cell has a lower Keep rate; it cannot tell stricter labels from harder postings inside a cell. field is rows.jsonl's posting pool field; source is the posting's ATS.

4a_t_hi_curve.grid_t_hi: [t_hi, true Keeps, wrong Keeps]; t_lo fixed; Keep needs s >= t_hi and passes H''

4a_matched_points.note: Curve readouts on test 4: the best true Keeps with at most the pick's wrong Keeps, and the fewest wrong Keeps with at least the pick's true Keeps. Chosen on the test-4 point estimate, so no interval applies; nothing here is a fit.

4b_readout.fit_rule: count match: tau so final Keep calls on the fit tests equal the pick's; Skip as now (s < t_lo)
4b_readout.margin_definition: z_Keep - max(z_Explore, z_Skip) on the raw first-token scores (= log P(Keep) - log max P(other))

base_rate_correction.how: P(Keep) times pi_new/pi_old, the other two times (1-pi_new)/(1-pi_old), renormalised; s recomputed; committed cut-offs kept. pi_new = test 3's pass rate is the non-oracle choice; the 7% row uses test 4's own gold and is a what-if.

soft_demotion_combo.fit_rule: net (true minus wrong Keeps) over all 32 subsets on the fit tests; ties to fewer categories

4d_averaging.fit_rule: P averaged per class; s = P(Keep) + 0.5 P(Explore); t_hi count-matched to the pick's Keep calls and t_lo to the pick's Skip calls (outside H'') on the fit tests

4e_veto.fit_rule: net on the fit tests; bar grid = every 2nd percentile of the other model's s over all rows, plus no veto; ties to the lower bar

4f_second_pass.circularity: gold equals label_A and label_B wherever they agree, and the adjudicator picks one of them elsewhere, so a reader that is label_A or label_B scored against gold is partly scored against itself: those rows are an upper bound only. The honest estimate is cross-labeler: reader B scored against label_A as the reference, and reader A against label_B.
4f_second_pass.band_fit_rule: net against the reference on the fit tests over lower edges t_lo..t_hi step 0.01; ties to the higher edge (fewer reads)

5_power.how: Pool = tests 1-4 rows (postings never cross tests). A synthetic lever flips rows at random: gains among gold Keeps the pick leaves in the Explore band, losses among the pick's true Keeps, drops among its wrong Keeps, adds among gold non-Keeps in the Explore band, at the per-gold-Keep rates below. A simulated test 5 draws postings with replacement from the mix until it holds N gold Keeps; its paired change gets a two-way bootstrap (1000 draws; rows within a drawn posting resampled multinomially); it clears when the true-Keep interval is above 0 and the wrong-Keep interval below 0. 300 simulated tests per point. Keep-enriched mix = rows from design cells (archetype x target_pass) whose tests 1-3 gold Keep rate is at least 15%: ['strong|True'].
